# Plant data.<br>Grounded in research. {.hero-title}

::: {.hero-intro}
Explore measurements of plant traits, crop yields, and ecosystem services, gathered from published research. Find evidence for ecological analyses, bioenergy research, and ecosystem models.
:::

## A shared resource for plant science {.section-heading}

These counts describe observations in this public snapshot, rather than the full reference catalogs. Each observation is identified by its source table and record ID.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
summary <- jsonlite::read_json("site-data/summary.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)
labels <- c(observations = "Observations", variables = "Measured variables",
            species = "Represented species", sites = "Research sites",
            sources = "Sources")
cat('<dl class="summary-grid" aria-label="Public dataset summary">')
for (key in names(labels)) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(summary[[key]]), length(summary[[key]]) == 1L,
            !is.na(summary[[key]]), summary[[key]] >= 0)
  cat(sprintf('<div class="summary-card"><dt>%s</dt><dd data-metric="%s">%s</dd></div>',
              labels[[key]], key, format(summary[[key]], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)))
}
cat('</dl>')
```

::: {.research-note}
## Know the data behind the result

This snapshot includes public records and excludes records flagged as failing quality control. Unchecked records remain available, so review quality flags, units, source citations, and study context before analysis. [Read the data-use guidance](about.qmd#data-use).
:::

## Built through collaboration {.section-heading}

BETYdb grew from research supported by the Energy Biosciences Institute and its founding partners. These original graphics acknowledge that historical support; they do not imply current sponsorship.
